title: Align System Architecture with Banking Objectives
problem_statement: Current system is a modernization platform, not a banking application. Need to either scope banking components or clarify business objectives.
risk_if_unaddressed: Complete project failure due to architecture-objective mismatch
suggested_approach: Conduct requirements analysis to determine if banking components should be added to current system or if objectives need rescoping
success_criteria: Clear alignment between system capabilities and business objectives
Defined scope for banking component integration

provenance.evidence: No banking components found in 290 files despite banking modernization objectives

title: Implement Banking-Grade Authentication
problem_statement: No authentication mechanisms suitable for retail banking customer access and regulatory compliance
risk_if_unaddressed: Regulatory violations, security breaches, customer data exposure
suggested_approach: Implement OAuth2/OIDC with MFA, session management, and audit logging for banking compliance
success_criteria: Audit trail for all authentication events

provenance.evidence: Security agent exists but no banking auth implementation

title: Replace File Storage with Banking Database
problem_statement: JSON file storage insufficient for banking transaction integrity, ACID compliance, and regulatory requirements
risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption, transaction failures, regulatory violations, audit failures
suggested_approach: Implement PostgreSQL or similar ACID-compliant database with encryption at rest and in transit
success_criteria: Data encryption at rest and in transit

provenance.evidence: File-based JSON storage detected, inappropriate for banking

title: Develop Core Banking Transaction Services
problem_statement: Missing all core banking services: deposits, withdrawals, balance inquiry, interest calculation
risk_if_unaddressed: Cannot fulfill basic banking functionality requirements
suggested_approach: Develop RESTful banking services with transaction validation, balance management, and interest calculation engines
success_criteria: Deposit service with validation and limits

provenance.evidence: No banking transaction services found in system

title: Define Legacy VB6 Migration Strategy
problem_statement: No clear path for migrating from legacy VB6 banking systems to current Python architecture
risk_if_unaddressed: Cannot retire legacy systems or migrate existing banking operations
suggested_approach: Analyze legacy VB6 systems, design migration strategy, implement data transformation and integration layers

provenance.evidence: OCX retirement mentioned but no legacy components found in system
